terra.problem: Planning the killing makes it intentional, but it does not establish that the man had prior malice, much less plenty of it.
The passage does not say the man flees from his home. He could be somewhere else when he starts running.
Saying the job was handed out to the three tribes adds an assignment the passage does not state. It says the cities belonged to them.
The statement that Moab is a neighboring nation is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
